user.title: Set up Liquid Glass
user.description: Installs DASH6 Satin Glass, Ultra Card and missing card dependencies automatically (internet required). LIQUID-GLASS-DEMO copies DASH6 with local browser simulation and no HA entities, without Florin; a separate card/GUI gallery is included. Optional LIQUID-GLASS-HUE-DEMO controls real Hue/light/switch entities discovered on this HA instance. Installation never switches devices. Dual Smart Thermostat needs another restart and manual device configuration.

data.hue_dashboard: Create LIQUID-GLASS-HUE-DEMO with real local devices

data_description.demo_mode: browser: local simulation without HA entities or Recorder data. entities: optional legacy mode with registered HA test entities. Existing installations keep their mode.
